title: gilia aggregata subsp. bridgesii
intro: Gilia aggregata subsp. bridgesii, commonly known as Skyrocket Gilia, is a perennial plant species native to the southwestern United States and Mexico. It is a member of the Polemoniaceae family and is valued for its medicinal properties. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, respiratory problems, and digestive issues, due to its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gilia aggregata subsp. bridgesii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
